data.name: Eco-hotel
data.abstract: This dataset includes Online Textual Reviews from both online (e.g., TripAdvisor) and offline (e.g., Guests' book) sources from the Areias do Seixo Eco-Resort.

additional_info.summary:
The CSV holds one cell per review, except the first row, which is the header.
All the 401 reviews were collected between January and August of 2015.
